annotations.title: Change one Google Ads keyword's bid or status

description: Change ONE Google Search keyword: its own max CPC (cpcBidUsd, the account currency), clearBid:true (it bids the ad group's default again), and / or status ENABLED or PAUSED. Find adGroupId and keywordId (the criterion id) with google_ads_report over keyword_view. Pausing or lowering is always safe. Raising the bid, or switching the keyword on, under a LIVE campaign and ad group raises real spend: show the user, get a yes, then confirm:true. On automated bidding (Maximize conversions, target CPA, …) Google sets bids itself and the reply says a keyword bid is not used. Removing a keyword is delete_google_ads_object level keyword. Read back from Google. Free.

clearBid.description: true = drop its own bid and use the ad group's

confirm.description: true only after the user approved a change that can raise spend on a LIVE campaign

cpcBidUsd.description: the keyword's own max CPC, account currency

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits; omit for the brand's selected default account

dryRun.description: true = Google validates it and nothing changes

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id when acting through one; omit otherwise
